purpose: Deterministic trigger rules controlling specialist-domain audit coverage. This file defines applicability; the campaign-local registry records decisions.
decisionRules: Evaluate every domain; no blank/unfiled domain is permitted.
If any positive trigger is observed, status MUST be TRIGGERED.
If evidence is incomplete, conflicting, ambiguous, or a reasonable trigger cannot be excluded, status MUST be UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE.
UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE is operationally identical to TRIGGERED for review/execution obligations; uncertainty never permits skipping specialist coverage.
NOT_TRIGGERED is permitted only after the positive trigger classes were actively evaluated and the required negative evidence is recorded.
Cost, inconvenience, lack of supplied tests, or agent preference are never applicability criteria.
A source revision or later evidence that can change a domain decision invalidates that decision and requires reevaluation before dependent phase work.

Every TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE domain creates explicit review/execution obligations for the phases named by the domain rule, unless a later phase records an evidence-bound typed limitation or a non-expressible disposition allowed by that phase.
Specialist modules/ledgers may be skipped only for a current exact-source-bound NOT_TRIGGERED decision.

domains.name: Upgradeability / Proxy Safety
positiveTriggers: storage-layout compatibility or implementation replacement can affect production state
negativeEvidenceRequired: no proxy/implementation dispatch or upgrade authority
no storage-layout dependency caused by upgrade architecture

domains.name: External Dependencies / Integrations
positiveTriggers: external contract/interface call whose behavior affects security
externally configured address or implementation dependency
failure/staleness/revert/return-value behavior of another contract affects correctness
negativeEvidenceRequired: no security-relevant external contract dependency beyond inert/native primitives
no externally supplied/configured contract behavior relied upon

domains.name: Cross-Chain / Messaging
positiveTriggers: chainId/domain separator/remote-chain state used for cross-chain authority
negativeEvidenceRequired: no cross-chain message or remote-state dependency

domains.name: Vault / Strategy / Share Accounting
positiveTriggers: vault receipt token represents claim on pooled assets
deposit/withdraw fees or share dilution/rounding affect ownership

domains.name: Oracle / Price / Rate
positiveTriggers: oracle/price feed/rate feed/exchange-rate input affects value or authorization
get_dy/quote/pricePerShare/shareRate or equivalent used as valuation
externally supplied price/rate affects mint/burn/borrow/liquidation/reward/fee logic
negativeEvidenceRequired: all conversions are fixed identities or purely internal deterministic accounting

domains.name: Lending / Debt / Liquidation
positiveTriggers: credit delegation or collateralized lending receipt accounting

domains.name: AMM / Pool / Hooks
positiveTriggers: Curve/Uniswap/Balancer or equivalent pool integration whose state affects security

domains.name: Signatures / Permits / Account Abstraction
negativeEvidenceRequired: no signature-derived authorization or replay-sensitive signed payload

domains.name: Off-Chain Critical Automation
positiveTriggers: privileged operational actor expected to call time-sensitive function
off-chain service failure can strand assets/rewards/accounting or security state
negativeEvidenceRequired: all security-critical lifecycle transitions are permissionless/on-chain self-contained
